testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The administrator has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system (UC2).

step.actions: admin: The administrator enters the following information about the hospital that conforms to the data formats in Section 5.6 and presses the Add Hospital button: Name Address State Zip
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: Delete hospital

step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction

testcase.summary: Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.preconditions: The administrator has authenticated themselves in the iTrust2 Medical Records system (UC2).

step.actions: admin: The administrator enters the following information about the hospital that conforms to the data formats in Section 5.6 and presses the Add Hospital button: Name Address State Zip
